# Check if there is a row where district is 'maryland 8' and incumbent is 'parren mitchell' and result is 're - elected'
# First, filter rows where district is exactly 'maryland 8'
district_filter = df['district'] == 'maryland 8'
# Then filter rows where incumbent is exactly 'parren mitchell'
incumbent_filter = df['incumbent'] == 'parren mitchell'
# Then filter rows where result is exactly 're - elected'
result_filter = df['result'] == 're - elected'
# Combine all filters
combined_filter = district_filter & incumbent_filter & result_filter
# Check if any row satisfies all conditions
answer = combined_filter.any()
